column1: # UP Summit X: the line map, line by line.
#   one page), supplied by the user 2026-09-29.
# Transcribed 2026-10-19 from the drawing: each line and the line it hangs
#   from. A parent that is not a line is where the cascade ends: a riser, or
#   the brake handle. The drawing does not say which riser the stabilo line
#   is fixed to, so it ends at "riser S".
# The map draws each row's cascade apart from the wing, and two things in it
#   are not in the names: a13 to a15, b13 and b14 hang from the stabilo line
#   STI, not from an A or B main; and b9, b10, c9 and c10 reach the B riser
#   through bc9 and bc10, one line for a b and a c anchor. b-ris, 80 mm, is
#   drawn on its own; the published totals put it under all three B mains.
